title: GraphEvent
description: The payload of every artifact-graph node event (docs/design/m0/13), discriminated by type: node.recorded/v1 and node.claimed/v1, under the node's id and in its project. internal/graph folds them into the graph projections in the writer transaction and refuses one its state does not derive. Result and selection events follow (plan 15 G3-2).

NodeRecorded.description: A node joins its task's graph, append-only: its task, its project and the node it succeeds (null for a first round).

NodeClaimed.description: A node's claim on its computation key (13 [G10]): its inputs as they resolved, fixed from here on, and the key they give. A claim is a node instance's: a repeat demand of the node joins it and records nothing; a memoizable kind's key is claimed once per task.

inputs.description: Each declared input and what it resolved to, in declared order: a result, or an approval with its revision. A new kind of resolution is a new event version (node.claimed/v2), since every field is required.
